_notes: detect: our own monitor (bots/compound-liquidator/monitor). It reads Comet over JSON-RPC, never holds a key and refuses every non-read RPC method. Needs Node >= 22.18 (runs .ts directly).
To add Ethereum and Arbitrum: set COMPOUND_CHAINS=base,ethereum,arbitrum here and ETHEREUM_RPC_URL / ARBITRUM_RPC_URL in bots/wrapper/.env.
paper: empty on purpose. Paper fills need the CompoundLiquidator contract's simulate() via eth_call with a state override; that is a later PR after the forge fork tests pass.
live: empty. Going live is Joshua's decision and a separate PR (contract review, deploy from his own wallet, FLEET_LIVE_COMPOUND_LIQUIDATOR=1).
Needs in bots/wrapper/.env (names only): BASE_RPC_URL. Optional: ETHEREUM_RPC_URL, ARBITRUM_RPC_URL, ETH_USD (fallback price), COMPOUND_SWAP_COST_BPS (default 30).
